segments.name: Energy Infrastructure
segments.description: Owns and operates solar power systems, smart microgrids and EV charging technology, selling power and licensing its AI platform to utilities and commercial off-takers.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in two reportable segments: Energy Infrastructure and Mobile Fuel Delivery.

segments.name: Mobile Fuel Delivery
segments.description: Delivers fuel on demand to individual consumers and commercial fleets through a fleet of fuel trucks and a proprietary mobile app.
segments.evidence: The Company's mobile fueling segment provides on-demand fuel delivery services through a growing fleet of fuel trucks operating across a national footprint.

revenueModel.text: Customers, from individual consumers to commercial fleets, pay for scheduled fuel delivery, while energy infrastructure customers pay through power purchase agreements, leases, SaaS and technology licensing.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenue is generated primarily from the sale and delivery of fuel.

changes.text: In 2025 the company combined its mobile fueling operations with its energy infrastructure business through a common control transaction, and it presents those two segments.
changes.evidence: The Company presents its consolidated financial statements with segments for mobile fuel delivery and energy infrastructure.
